caption: The drawing depicts a wooden wardrobe or armoire composed of two main vertical doors and a single large bottom drawer. The object is shown using brown tones to represent the wood grain texture, with visible curved patterns on both the doors and drawer fronts highlighting the natural wood appearance. The two doors have simple round handles, and metal hinges are depicted on their edges. The bottom drawer is fitted with two brass-colored handles. The wardrobe stands on four short, slightly squared legs. The background is a plain, off-white color with some scattered brownish-yellow specks and stains. The drawing is signed "Edward T. Jewett" in the lower right corner.
title: Cupboard
